text:
zoe (Design): Quick design ping 0min: microcopy + affordance for sampled heatmaps + a sampling-intensity slider in the timepicker. Proto: https://redwood.design/mini/sampler-slider :link

matt (Frontend): Can you TL;DR the user problem? Is it discovery or trusting numbers?

zoe (Design): Both. Users don't notice sampling at wide ranges and then get surprised when p95 changes after zoom. We want: 1) a low-friction label, 2) a way to visualize sample density across the time range (slider/overlay), 3) accessible fallback for patterns.

arun (Observability): Note: we already expose sample_ratio in API but not in UI. If we add a slider that shows sample-intensity per bucket, it should be client-side only (no extra workload). For exact p95 we queue async compute.

nina (A11y): Accessibility points: slider must be keyboardable with aria-valuetext like "Sampling density: 1 in 10". Pattern overlays ok only as an opt-in or high-contrast mode. Tooltips must have clear language for screen readers.

matt (Frontend): Implementation sketch: timepicker area show a faint bar under the scrubber representing sample density (height = density). Hovering shows "sample ratio 1:8" tooltip. Slider toggles sampling overlay opacity. For small widths collapse to a single "Sampled" chip that opens the panel.

zoe (Design): Microcopy ideas: Option A chip text: "Sampled" + tooltip "Estimated from sampled traces (1 in 10). Request full compute." Option B chip text: "Estimated" + tooltip "Showing estimates based on sampling. Compute exact p95 (async)." Thoughts?
arun (Observability): Prefer Option A for telemetry clarity. We'll tag events with chip_variant=A|B to test which reduces support churn. Also enforce rate limit 20/min/org on compute requests.
nina (A11y): If we use "Estimated" it's more user-friendly; "Sampled" is more technical. For screen readers the long tooltip should say "This result is estimated from a sample of traces: 1 in 10 were used."
matt (Frontend): Perf note: drawing the density bar is cheap; pattern overlays on canvas are more expensive. We'll only enable patterns when user opts-in. I'll prototype the SVG overlay + css toggle.

zoe (Design): Decision for sprint:
- chip: "Sampled" (A) for now; tooltip uses explicit sentence for clarity
- show sampling-density mini-bar under scrubber, hover for per-bucket ratio
- add a slider in timepicker settings to adjust overlay opacity (0-100) to help users with different screens
- patterns: opt-in via settings/high-contrast only
- keyboard shortcut: when scrubber focused, press "S" to open sampling panel; `aria-live` announces queue status

arun (Observability): I'll add telemetry and API notes: POST /compute-p95 -> {job_id, eta_seconds}. Cache 10m. Rate-limit and quota enforcement detailed in ticket.

matt (Frontend): I'll spike the density bar + chip behavior and post screenshots by Wed.
nina (A11y): I'll run keyboard + screen reader flows and colorblind sims on the proto.

zoe (Design): Thanks all  leaving open for small copy tweaks. If no objections I'll merge microcopy on Friday. :sparkles:
